entries.title: Psalms 97:1
segments:
PSALM XCVII. 
 
  Christ is the Alpha and Omega in this psalm.   His government speaks terror to his enemies, ver. 1-7.   And comfort to his friends, whom he preserves and delivers, ver. 8-12. 
 
  V. 1. Isles-The Gentile nations, as this word, used

entries.title: Psalms 97:2
segments: V. 2. Darkness-A dark cloud doth encompass him.

entries.title: Psalms 97:6
segments: V. 6. Heavens-The angels, yea God himself from heaven.

entries.title: Psalms 97:7
segments: V. 7. Confounded-Let them be ashamed of their folly.  Gods-All you whom the Gentiles have made the objects of their worship.

entries.title: Psalms 97:8
segments: V. 8. Zion-Thy people dwelling in Zion or Jerusalem, to whom Christ came.  Heard-The fame of thy judgments, and the setting up the kingdom of the Messiah.

entries.title: Psalms 97:11
segments: V. 11. Light-Joy and happiness.  Sown-Is laid up for them.
